meta.title: Date & Time Calculator - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Calculate the exact difference between two dates including years, months, and days.
steps_time-diff_1Desc: Input a start date/time and an end date/time using the datetime pickers. Both past and future dates are supported for any calculation direction.
steps_time-diff_2Desc: Click Calculate to see the exact time span between your dates. Results break down into years, months, days, hours, minutes, and seconds.
steps_time-diff_3Desc: Click Copy to grab the time difference. Useful for project planning, age calculation, countdown timers, SLA tracking, and event scheduling.
desc: Calculate the exact difference between two dates including years, months, and days.
